evals.prompt: 帮我完整研究中芯国际
expected_behavior: trigger invest-analysis-pro
select specialist by default rather than quick
read evidence-contract, dag-workflow, report-standard, and workflow-manifest before synthesis
fetch a full evidence bundle and perform an explicit Evidence Audit
dispatch Technical, Intel, and Fundamentals & Flow as first-wave role tasks
dispatch Risk only after the first wave completes
dispatch 1-3 Strategy Specialist branches rather than only reading strategy YAML inline
keep Decision in the controller session rather than dispatching it
render the report from bundled output assets
output Decision Dashboard JSON that follows the bundled schema
output an Evidence Audit Appendix
use the compliance protocol only when strict validation or runtime debugging is needed
emit WORKFLOW_DEVIATION if a material mandatory node or deliverable is missing

evals.prompt: 快速看看大唐发电的技术面就行
expected_behavior: recognize the explicit quick request
select quick mode
use compact quote, technical, ma, and volume evidence
run the Technical Analyst path
still output Decision Dashboard JSON and an Evidence Audit Appendix
not expand into the full specialist DAG by default
keep the execution path lightweight unless strict validation is explicitly needed

evals.prompt: 分析 688981，如果新闻或者资金流拿不到也继续，但要告诉我缺什么
expected_behavior: 允许 status=partial 继续分析
披露 failed/partial 模块、errors、warnings 和 source_chain
降低受影响结论的置信度
不得编造缺失新闻、资金流或基本面字段

evals.prompt: 用 bull_trend 和 shrink_pullback 两个策略评估贵州茅台
expected_behavior: 读取对应 strategies/*.yaml
把策略 YAML 作为 Strategy Specialist 的输入
Strategy Specialist 只判断 evidence 是否满足策略条件
最终是否采纳策略由主控在标准报告中综合决定

evals.prompt: 我不会用命令行，帮我研究一下宁德时代
expected_behavior: 不要求用户手动运行 CLI
由 Agent 自行调用内部数据适配层
保持用户可见入口为自然语言研究请求
最终输出研究报告而不是命令教程

evals.prompt: 我这里贴了行情和新闻摘要，但你不能运行本地命令，帮我基于这些数据分析一下
expected_behavior: 选择 Provided evidence mode
不要求用户手动运行命令
基于用户提供的 evidence 继续 DAG
明确披露数据来源、缺口和置信度影响

evals.prompt: 不能联网也不能运行命令，我也没有数据，但帮我判断这只股票能买吗
expected_behavior: 选择 No evidence mode
不编造行情、新闻、财务或资金流数据
说明无法完成研究判断
列出完成研究所需的 evidence 模块

evals.prompt: 帮我简短输出贵州茅台的研究摘要，但不要省略关键风险
expected_behavior: 使用 Brief 摘要报告形态
保留标的、操作倾向、分数、一句话结论和生成时间
如果 evidence 为 partial 或存在关键风险，不因简短模式省略风险和数据缺口

evals.prompt: 帮我分析特变电工，按 invest-analysis-pro 默认流程完整执行。当前 runtime 支持 subagent / sessions_spawn。
expected_behavior: select specialist mode by default
treat an independent-dispatch-capable runtime as requiring independent role-task dispatch
read each role prompt before dispatch
use the standard payload template asset for role tasks
dispatch first-wave researchers, then dependency-gated Risk and Strategy nodes
do not collapse all branch opinions into a single controller-only narrative
output Full Markdown Report, Decision Dashboard JSON, and Evidence Audit Appendix in that order
emit WORKFLOW_DEVIATION if any mandatory dispatch or deliverable is skipped

evals.prompt: 按 invest-analysis-pro 默认 specialist 流程分析隆基绿能。当前 runtime 支持 sessions_spawn 和 structured artifact return，但 callable subagent list 为空。
expected_behavior: select specialist mode by default
do not treat an empty callable-subagent list as no-dispatch
self-spawn same-agent workers for mandatory role tasks when dedicated callable specialists are unavailable
produce separate role artifacts instead of only absorbed controller reasoning
assemble Decision Dashboard JSON and Evidence Audit Appendix before the final user-facing report
render the final package from bundled templates rather than writing a freehand narrative first

evals.prompt: 按 invest-analysis-pro 默认 specialist 流程严格执行，分别给出技术、情报、基本面/资金流、风险、策略分支输入，不要合并成一个主控口吻。
expected_behavior: read each required role prompt before dispatch
preserve role separation instead of replacing it with a single controller narrative
treat Risk as dependency-gated after the first wave
treat Strategy Specialist as real branch execution rather than inline YAML commentary
keep Decision in the controller session

evals.prompt: 当前 runtime 不支持 subagent dispatch。按 invest-analysis-pro 默认流程分析特变电工，但如果只能串行就明确标出来。
expected_behavior: select specialist mode by default
use sequential fallback only because independent task execution is unavailable
emit WORKFLOW_DEVIATION: no_subagent_dispatch when the run is being formally validated
still produce the required report, dashboard json, and evidence audit appendix
surface the compliance shortfall explicitly during strict validation

evals.prompt: 严格按 invest-analysis-pro 产出结果，并在结束前做流程合规检查。
expected_behavior: produce a workflow run record
validate it with scripts/check_workflow_compliance.py before the final answer
treat non-compliance as a stop condition rather than silently proceeding
use workflow-manifest.json and decision-dashboard.schema.json as the machine-readable validation sources
